text:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Data Engineering Intern position at Kestrel Data. As a Computer Science and Engineering student at the Pune Institute of Technology with a CGPA of 8.6, I am eager to apply my technical background to your data engineering initiatives.

My academic projects and internship experience have given me a solid foundation in software development and data handling. During my time as a Machine Learning Intern at Brightcart Retail Analytics, I built a retrieval-augmented chatbot over 4,000 product manuals using Python, FastAPI, and pgvector. I also containerised the service with Docker and deployed it on a company virtual machine. In addition, I have hands-on project experience building applications such as StudyBuddy, which generates flashcards from uploaded PDFs with structured JSON output validated by Pydantic and was used by 120 classmates during end-semester exams. 

My technical toolkit includes Python, JavaScript, SQL, C++, PostgreSQL, Docker, Git, and Linux. While I am still expanding my experience with specific tools like Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, and cloud platforms, my strong background in Python, SQL, and Linux positions me well to quickly learn and contribute to the team at Kestrel Data. 

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my skills align with your needs.

Sincerely,

Alex Rao
